Class ListState

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.list.ListState
public final class ListState extends Object
State for a List widget, tracking selection and scroll offset.

    • applyStickyScroll

      public void applyStickyScroll(int totalItems, int totalHeight, int visibleHeight)
      Applies sticky scroll logic.

      Auto-scrolls to the end when new items are added, but pauses when the user has scrolled away. Resumes when the user scrolls back to the bottom.

      Parameters:
      totalItems - the total number of items
      totalHeight - the total content height in rows
      visibleHeight - the visible viewport height
